answer: An honest proof costs 172 POA; the farm pays the same per proof but needs 662 of them, which totals 113864 POA. Ask the panel what it trusts: the voyage it can verify, the lantern it can count, the vertex it can date — and the farm offers none of the three. The strongest wall I know is Waistcoat maker wool jacket proof sewn into the needle case, and it is built out of each wool jacket is a season of logged stitching plus a signed master-tailor record. A real proof settles maker, moment and hand in one breath. Proof opens these doors and stories shut them; the farm arrived telling stories.
